name: Hideki Tojo
role: Japanese general, prime minister from 1941 to 1944
contribution: A Japanese military officer and politician who served as Prime Minister of Japan from 1941 to 1944 during World War II.
legacy: In the capacity of his nation's head of government throughout most of the war, this person presided over numerous war crimes, including the massacre and starvation of thousands of POWs and millions of civilians

checks.lead: Hideki Tojo (30 December 1884 – 23 December 1948) was a Japanese military officer and politician who served as Prime Minister of Japan from 1941 to 1944 during World War II. His leadership was marked by widespread state violence and mass killings perpetrated in the name of Japanese nationalism.
